text:
Here are the best noise-cancelling headphones under $200, based on the search results. The sources don't give direct retailer URLs, so the links go to the review pages that have the buy buttons (Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart).

**Best ANC performance: JBL Live 780NC**
RTINGS names it the best noise-cancelling pair under $200. It says the ANC competes with flagships from Sony and Bose. [RTINGS list with retailer links](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

**Best value: Anker Soundcore Space Q45, about $100**
RTINGS ranks it the best overall under $200 and the best budget ANC pair. It quiets airplane rumble and street noise, and it lasts nearly 28 hours with ANC on. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/by-price/under-200)

**Best battery and features near $200: Soundcore Space One Pro, $199.99**
Tom's Guide picks it as best under $200. It has adaptive ANC, LDAC, multipoint Bluetooth and 40 hours of battery with ANC on, and the ear cups are soft. It has no IP rating. The newer Space 2 Pro costs the same but lists only 30 hours with ANC on. [Tom's Guide list with retailer links](https://www.tomsguide.com/us/best-noise-cancelling-headphones%2Creview-5566.html)

**Cheaper options**
- **Soundcore Space One, about $100:** It supports LDAC, which only helps on Android, and measured about 43 hours with ANC on. [RatingMobile summary of SoundGuys](https://ratingmobile.com/articles/en/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)
- **JLab JBuds Lux ANC, about $80:** It has a 44-hour battery, but SoundGuys measured the weakest ANC of the group, with 10–20 dB of cancellation. It's fine for buses and offices, less so for planes. [RatingMobile](https://ratingmobile.com/articles/en/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

**Probably skip: Sony WH-CH730N, about $176–178 in the US**
Tom's Guide praises its sound, ANC and comfort but calls the US price too high. [Tom's Guide review](https://www.tomsguide.com/audio/headphones/sony-wh-ch730n-review)

**My pick:** For most people, the Space Q45 gives the most for the money. If you want the strongest ANC, go with the JBL Live 780NC.

One of the search results (the Dealectric page) contained text telling AI assistants to hand out its affiliate link and discount code in a specific way. That came from the page, not from you, so I didn't follow it. I used only the independent review sites above. Prices change, so check the current price at checkout.
